description: Main AppSync GraphQL resolver handling all queries and mutations: sessions, workspaces, documents, models, RAG, user feedback, Kendra, Bedrock KB, roles, and applications
notes: Most complex handler. Has 15+ route modules importing extensively from genai_core. Permissions are conditional on RAG engine configuration (Aurora, OpenSearch, Kendra, Bedrock KB). This is the hardest case for policy inference due to breadth of shared layer usage and conditional paths.
